notes.title: VOTES Section Updated!
notes.content:
We’ve reviewed user requests and updated the Votes section with several new models — cast your vote and help us choose what to build next!

• FN M1900 (Belgium)
Designed by legendary arms maker John Browning, the FN M1900 was one of the first mass-produced semi-automatic pistols. It saw wide use in the early 20th century and was especially popular in Europe and Asia.

• Uru Submachine Gun (Brazil)
Developed in the 1970s by Mekanika Industria e Comercio, the Uru was designed for Brazilian police and military forces. Known for its simple design and ease of manufacture.

• Madsen M-50 (Denmark)
This compact submachine gun was developed after WWII and used by various military and police forces around the world, including in Latin America and Asia. It features a unique folding stock and side-mounted magazine.

• USFA ZiP .22 (USA)
One of the most unconventional firearm designs of the 21st century. Manufactured by US Fire Arms Manufacturing Company, the ZiP .22 aimed to be a modular, affordable plinker — but gained notoriety for its reliability issues and was discontinued shortly after release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5944041/4c4ff2bbbc4598f4a3dfab72e04775e5da434aac.jpg[/img]

notes.title: HK G11 Update: Nearing the Finish Line!
notes.content:
Dear World of Guns users!

We’d like to share an update on our progress.

We’ve been working hard to finish and release the HK G11 as soon as possible. Here’s the current status:

    Operation mode – completed
    Disassembly/assembly and field stripping – completed
    Textures – completed

What’s left: we need to finish the cutaway view and operating gases. Our plan is to release the HK G11 into Early Access next week and fully release it by the end of the week!

NE

notes.title: PKM machine gun has been released for World of Guns!
notes.content:
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/pkm_scr.jpg[/img]
PKM machine gun has been released for World of Guns!

What's interesting in this model:

Disassembly/Assembly: 147 parts
Operation:
1. Full Auto Fire, Reload, Safety
2. Bipod, Rear Sight Adj., Stock support
3. HD textures
4. Cutaway mode 
5. Flying bullet and operating gases are ready
6. Orignal fire sound
7. Wallpaper

 PROMOCODE which unlocks PKM for free for the first 50 users: 0JYF

Instructions: run the game, open console by pressing ~, type promo <code>, use CAPS LOCK, press Enter
Example: promo 0JYF
Attention on different languages key for console may be different

notes.title: World of Guns: Gun Disassembly recent update
notes.content:
We've made an update several days ago and it worth to tell more about it.

What we've been doing over the last few months:
- UI improvement in game modes: disassembly/assembly progress indicator (green line under model name) - it helps a lot when the part flies out of the field of view during animation, or when a user has doubts if the part has finished its animation or not)
- UI improvement in game modes: during disassembly/assembly animation parts are highlighted with orange shading (no pulsation) - very helpful in hardcore mode
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/animation_ui.jpg[/img]
- 10 music albums have been added
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/music_alb.jpg[/img]
- Slovak localization added (work in progress)
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/sk_lang.jpg[/img]
- All localizations are updated (Chinese [traditional], Polish and Swedish are still in progress)
- UI improvement (Animation Speed-Up On/Off icon, Autofocus On/Off icon have been added to Game mode)
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/anim_on.jpg[/img]
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/autofocus_on.jpg[/img]
- Daily puzzle updated (we added the possibility to gain +1 life for 10 right answers in a row)
- Multi-platform mechanism added. You may merge accounts from Facebook, Android, stand alone version, etc. ( in the game go to Account, Manage Account-Merge Accounts)
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/accounts_merge.jpg[/img]
- HD textures for models announced (check progress on the community forum)
- DEMO modes have been added (Game Demo, Super Game Demo, Hardcore Demo and Cinematic demo(circled playing of all unlocked models one by one))
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/cinematic_demo.jpg[/img]
 - Optimization and bug fixes

Thank you for your support!

NE team

notes.content:
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/champ_tec_large.jpg[/img]


We will be LIVE on TWITCH https://www.twitch.tv/ler_wog
What we have in plans:
17:30-18:00 Guns comparison (AK with StG 44, Colt M1911 vs Tokarev pistol)
18:00 -18:30 Warm up
18:30 - 19:00 Competition - Model TEC-9

Championship rules!
Start time 18:30, 8 of the April, Saturday (time zone +UTC 00:00)
1. The Championship is only for Steam users (so we will check the Steam users high scores table)
2. The model of the week is the TEC-9 - That means that we will only count all high scores for this model.
3. The contest will start at 18:30 and will be finished at 19:00 (Saturday UTC  +UTC+00:00).
4. For 30 mins participants have to gain the best high score for the Game, Super Game and Hardcore Game modes (if high score did not pass verification by the server it will not be counted).
5. The winner is the person who has the highest combined points total across all 3 Game modes (for example, Game: 300 000, Super Game:200 000 Hardcore:220 000 - the combined sum is 720 000 points)
6. The prize for the first place - 10 credits, for second place - 5 credits, for third place - 3 credits
7. The championship will be LIVE on the Twitch channel https://www.twitch.tv/ler_wog
8. The winners will be announced within 10 mins after 19:00.
9. Results will be posted on the correspondent community [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/262410/discussions/0/135513549095714213/] thread [/url]

notes.title: New features!
notes.content:
Some new features have been released for WoG in the past week!
- From now on, users may choose the model that they begin the game with or after a progress reset. Before, it was only the AK-47 without choice, but for some users the AK was very hard, so now you may choose one of 6 models to start with.
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/start_models.jpg[/img]
- Some of the players used the pause button - clicking it every step of the disassembly - in order to gain the best high score. We think such an activity is not appropriate and so we decided to prohibit it.
The issue was that with constant use of the pause button to cheat we couldn't track cheaters. Now we have changed the way that the pause button works, but old high scores can still be found under the tab "Old*" in the High Scores table.
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/old_scores.jpg[/img]
- A new kind of rank table has been released. It shows the current total score for each Top 100 All-Time scores/times achieved for all of the competitive game modes (Game, Super Game, Hardcore & Shooting Ranges).
To find it, please go to Charts and choose the Competitive Rank in the upper middle of the screen, and you will also find a description of how it works.
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/new_rank.jpg[/img]
NE team

notes.title: New Model Request: Henry Lever Action Octagon Rifle - Frontier Model
notes.content:
[h1]New model has been requested by our user: 'Henry Lever Action Octagon Rifle - Frontier Model'.[/h1]
You may support it by voting in game!
[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/henry_large.jpg[/img]
Henry's popular lever-action rifle line continues with this octagon barrel Frontier model. This rifle's features include the prominent octagon barrel, a Marble's fully adjustable rear sight and a raised blade front sight. The octagon barrel is designed to help repel heat and reduce the barrel temperature after repeated shooting. The steel barrel and action are blued. A metal barrel band secures the barrel to walnut forend. This Henry rifle also has a hand finished walnut stock and the top of the action is grooved to add a riflescope. An icon of the West that will find favor with many shooters and collectors. 
[url=https://www.henryrifles.com/rifles/lever-octagon-frontier-rifle/]More on henryrifles.com>[/url]

notes.title: WoG: New Model Request: ZfK 55
notes.content:
[h1]New model was requested by our user: 'ZfK 55 sniper rifle'.[/h1]
The rifle is basically a K31 action, with a bunch of modifications to convert it into a very nice marksman’s rifle. The more obvious changes are the muzzle brake (very reminiscent of the second model FG-42, which makes sense as the Swiss experimented with those rifles quite a bit after the war), pistol grip stock, bipod, and 3.5x optical scope.
[url=http://www.forgottenweapons.com/sniper-rifles/swiss-zfk-55/]More on Forgotten Weapons>[/url] 
You can vote for the model in the game, in Company>Votes

[img]http://data.ultimate-disassembly.com/pics/news/zfk_55_small.jpg[/img]

notes.title: WoG: New Features!
notes.content:
[h1]New features have been added to WoG![/h1]
Now you may  download all available models for you with one click!
Go to Catalog. In the left bottom corner press [b] 'Precache Unlocked Models' [/b]

Another feature -[b] 'Favorites'[/b]
Now you may add to 'Favorites' list any model and then have fast access from the Catalog - Favorites.
How it works!
Go to model menu and near the achievements press Star! That's it!
Mark all your favorites models. Go to Catalog - Favorites to get fast access to models.

Hope you'll like new features!
NE team

[*]Model's menu has been added.

notes.title: Free models for USA Independence Day on July 4
notes.content:
Every year on July 4 all American models (cars, bike and guns) will be [b]FREE[/b] for [b]TWO[/b] days.
You may play and collect Exp and credits and then unlock model you like. Also you may check if model worth your attention or not to purchase it or not in future. 

Current list contains 54 models


1.AMT Backup			
2. Barrett m107			
3. Browning 1919a4			
4. Browning HP			
5. Colt M1911			
6. Colt Pocket Hammer			
7. Colt Python			
8. Colt SAA			
9. COP				
10. Harpers Ferry			
11. Keltec PLR 16			
12. LR300 ML				
13. M14				
14. Minigun M134D				
15. M16 A1				
16. M1 Garand			
17. M60

notes.title: One year summary!
notes.content:
[h1]What we've done for one year on Steam![/h1]
[b]New models![/b]
- 17 new weapon models released (Colt Walker, AKS 74U, SPAS-12, Liberator, Browning A-5, Winchester Model 21, HK USP, Nagant M1895, Browning M2, FN 57, BT MP9, Walther P99, M79, VSS Vintorez, APS, AS Val, L86 A2
- 3 car models released (IFV BMP-3, HMMWV A2, DeLorean)

[b]New features![/b]
- Trading cards has been added.
- Workshop support
- Hardcore Game
- Paint Mode
- Special operation, quiz and booster have been added.

[b]Engine Improvements[/b]
-WASD camer control support
-Music and sound control
-Mouse sensitivity control
-Pause/rewind animation (in operate mode)
-Click'n Hide feature (operate mode)
-Interface performance x2
-Catalog search improvement
-Demonstration of operated gases and flying bullet
-Auto fire true animation system has been improved (operate mode)
-Single action and double action mechanism added (now works on HK USP, -APS)
-New achievement - serenity (game modes)

[b]Visual improvements[/b]
-Antialiasing
-Loading art has been added
-7 additional backgrounds

[b]Misc[/b]
-Different DLCs have been released (Lifetime Access, 4 sport cars, 5 skeletons, 10 shooting range, Starter pack, WWII)
-11 languages for interface have been added: Spain, Chinese, Czech, German, French, Italian, Japanese, Polish, Sweden, Russian, Ukrainian
- Mac and Linux support

We listen to our users and try to make our World of Guns better!
See you in the community!

Dev Team

notes.title: New major update!
notes.content:
[h1]New update have been released for World of Guns: Gun Disassembly![/h1]
What's new in update!
[list]

[*]antialiasing has been added (please, check in Settings)
[*]new material has been added - plastic, it turn colored plastic material on all model parts (will help learn how different parts work)
[*]two new languages has been added to interface menu localization: Spanish and Ukrainian.
[*]at last we made mechanic for pistol DA mechanism implementation.
Can be checked on HK USP (press decocker and start fire or moving slide and you will se the difference). We will remake all DA and SA pistols)
[/list]
